description: This Java class 'RitaServices' provides payment processing services such as credit card authorization, capture, void, refund, and related operations interfacing with the Rita API within the OFBiz framework. It handles payment transactions, credit card info setup, and configuration management.

classes.name: RitaServices
classes.description: A utility class providing payment processing services via Rita API within OFBiz framework.

methods.name: ccAuth
methods.description: Performs credit card authorization, sends transaction to Rita API, and returns the result with authorization details.

methods.name: ccCapture
methods.description: Captures a previously authorized transaction using Rita API.

methods.name: ccVoidRelease
methods.description: Void or release a pre-authorization based on the context.

methods.name: ccVoidRefund
methods.description: Refunds a captured transaction via Rita API.

methods.name: ccCreditRefund
methods.description: Performs a credit refund for a transaction.

methods.name: ccRefund
methods.description: Handles refund process, determining whether to void or refund based on terminal state.

methods.name: setCreditCardInfo
methods.description: Sets credit card details into Rita API request from context and credit card entity.

methods.name: getApi
methods.description: Creates and configures RitaApi instance based on properties and payment type.

methods.name: buildPccProperties
methods.description: Builds properties for Rita API configuration from entity properties and context.

methods.name: getAmountString
methods.description: Formats amount from context with proper scale and rounding for API.
